text: just seen a girl in the library at 11pm. 40 page lecture pdf. three highlighters. no flashcards. no practice test. no quizlet. just her and a yellow highlighter reading the same paragraph for the fourth time. final is friday. Absolute madness
base_video: Student sitting at a library desk facing the camera, laptop half closed, chewing gum, slowly looking off to the side and back at the lens with zero expression. One small shake of the head at the end.
audio: original audio, room tone (library hum, a chair scraping)
caption: she has 4 days and one highlighter
why_this_brand: The 40 page lecture PDF plus highlighter loop is the exact Quizlet pain point of notes you cannot actually revise from.
